WHO WE ARE
We are an Agile Technology Services and Systems Integration company with 15+ years of experience delivering enterprise Cloud, Cybersecurity, Business Applications, and Managed Services across Egypt, GCC, and MEA.
Backed by Strategic Partnerships with Leading Global Technology Vendors, the company began as a technology practice within IT Fusion Software House in 2011 and became an independent entity in 2017.
